title: Hood Code: Loyalty To Sin
body:
15 Minutes w/ The Captains · 2026-03-11

Opens [Lev 5](/bible/leviticus/5) · [Exod 20](/bible/exodus/20) · [Hos 4](/bible/hosea/4) · [Prov 17](/bible/proverbs/17) · [Sir 13](/bible/sirach/13) · [Prov 24](/bible/proverbs/24) · [Isa 59](/bible/isaiah/59)
## Introduction *[[0:21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I29gmYaeFO0&t=21s)]* Captain Matt here, IUIC Baton Rouge. Today's topic is hood code: loyalty to sin, betrayal to justice. Notice it said hood, not neighborhood. Cuz neighbor is gone now. It's just hood, cuz we don't love each other. We have a code, one of many, that's talking about no snitching. So Tyrone killed Ray Ray. It's wrong for me, as an innocent bystander who was there when Tyrone killed Ray Ray, to tell the police, hey, he did it. They'll call me a snitch. They'll call me a rat. But yet if the police kill Ray Ray, and I told on the police, I'm a hero. What world are y'all living in? We going to be all the way one way or we going to be all the way another way. We can't have selective outrage. Either we going to be all the way righteous, kings and gods of the earth, or we going to be African Americans, Negroes, the thing that was created in Babylon. Which one are we going to be? ## Scriptures Opened **[Leviticus 5:1](/bible/leviticus/5#v1)** *[[1:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I29gmYaeFO0&t=117s)]* > [1](/bible/leviticus/5#v1) And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity. - And if a soul sin: if somebody breaks the law. That's what sin is. Sin is the breaking of the law. - And is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it: whether you saw it or whether you know of it. Why is that important? Because in the judicial system, if you have knowledge of a crime, let's say murder, you have knowledge of the person that did the murder, they can charge you with accessory. You knew about it, but you didn't say nothing. You're charged as an accessory. - If he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity: you bear the iniquity of the person that actually did it. - We got to understand that change in our neighborhood is not going to come from outside. It got to come from within. We got to be the ones to put value on our life in order for others to put value on our life. - A clip is played of Boosie saying: "You have to start giving these cops the death penalty... They have to be more obligated than people on the streets. They're trained." Stop. How you going to set the police to a higher standard? Oh, they're trained. They're put here to protect. And what you here to do? Destroy? You not here to protect your people? Cuz every time a police kill our people, you want to protest. You want to say black lives matter. You want to hoop and holler. They trained, but what are you? - I was watching Higher Learning the other day. That little white boy said, they out there training, killing and shooting each other every day. They ready for war. We trained too. We training out there killing each other. Y'all taking y'all rap lyrics and pumping that spirit into the community about killing this person and killing that person. Brothers be having beef with each other talking about, I'm not going to go back and forth cuz somebody going to end up dying. Why somebody got to die cuz you have a problem with your brother? **[Exodus 20:13](/bible/exodus/20#v13)** *[[4:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I29gmYaeFO0&t=292s)]* > [13](/bible/exodus/20#v13) Thou shalt not kill. - This is the problem with the black community. All of the crime that happened to us from other people, we get emotional. But when it happened to us from us, we turn a blind eye. - Thou shalt not kill: very simple. How hard is that? To not want to murder your brother. To not want to murder your sister. Cuz who fill up the jails? We do. - Do other races kill each other? Yes, of course. But it ain't white-on-white crime. It ain't Chinese-on-Chinese crime. It ain't Japanese-on-Japanese crime. It ain't African-on-African crime. It's black-on-black crime. The example that we set to the others in other countries: that's why Africans get over here and act the way that they do. Because in the media we're portrayed as pants-sagging, drug-using, drug-dealing, murdering criminals. **[Hosea 4:1-2](/bible/hosea/4#v1)** *[[6:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I29gmYaeFO0&t=372s)]* > [1](/bible/hosea/4#v1) Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel: for the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land. > > [2](/bible/hosea/4#v2) By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood. - Because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land: we don't have truth. We always lying. Always trying to get over on somebody. We have no knowledge of God. We have no mercy. We are the most unmerciful people towards one another. And yet when nobody else shows us mercy, we get all butt hurt. No. If we want mercy, we got to show it to ourselves first. What, you think this going to be an external solution to an internal problem? No. - By swearing, and lying, and killing: we lie to one another. We be swearing up and down. That whole on King David, on my mama, on my soul. That's swearing. How you going to put something on something that you don't even own? It ain't even yours. Remember, Christ said, don't swear at all. - And stealing: that's why people get their cars stole. They be breaking into stuff. When black people get killed by the police, what's the first thing we do? We loot. Set things on fire and steal. - And committing adultery: you got Usher kissing women in the mouth, messing up whole marriages. You got men that's always talking about taking your female. Boosie got songs like that. And it ain't just an attack on him. It's all them rappers that do it. And yes, we were guilty of it at one time. But you got to wake up and become a man. - They break out, and blood toucheth blood: blood touching blood is black people touching black people. Their lives are ending by the hands of other black people. Black-on-black crime. We got to stop that. And then when a black-on-black crime happen, we don't want to do anything about it. We don't want to say nothing. **[Proverbs 17:15](/bible/proverbs/17#v15)** *[[8:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I29gmYaeFO0&t=539s)]* > [15](/bible/proverbs/17#v15) He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the Lord. - A change has to happen. That's why I don't subscribe to every single thing that Charleston White say, but a whole lot of the stuff that this brother be saying about the gangs, about the hood, about the ghetto, a lot of that stuff be on point. And we as a people should be ashamed that we put that stuff on a high pedestal. We should be ashamed that we okay with one man that's black killing another man that's black. And that go for you Hispanics as well. Y'all ain't different. Cartels fighting against this cartel, doing diabolical stuff to one another. But then when bad stuff happen to you from the outside, now you want to cry. No. - He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the Lord: that's what people do. They condemn us. We've had people in the hood call the police on us for reading the Bible. And yet when we go out there to try to help ease the crime, now we looked at as snitches and rats. - Free my dog. Free my boy. Your boy just murdered a whole group of people. Free him. RIP this person: a mass murderer in the hood. He finally got murdered. Now you're saying RIP to this man. That's what we do. In society, we put murderers and killers and evildoers on a pedestal. We justify them. Most of them made it out that life and they're still talking about it, fueling that lifestyle in the ghetto right now. **[Sirach 13:23](/bible/sirach/13#v23)** *[[11:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I29gmYaeFO0&t=663s)]* > [23](/bible/sirach/13#v23) When a rich man speaketh, every man holdeth his tongue, and, look, what he saith, they extol it to the clouds: but if the poor man speak, they say, What fellow is this? and if he stumble, they will help to overthrow him. - And this is mainly why it happens. This is how it's able to keep happening. - When a rich man speaketh, every man holdeth his tongue: when NBA YoungBoy say it, when Meek Mill and Jay-Z want to push reform, when Boosie say something, they want to push reform. Everybody hold their tongue. - And, look, what he saith, they extol it to the clouds: oh man, y'all heard what Boosie said? Yeah, speak on, bro. Y'all amen-ing all of that stuff, but when we come out there with the Bible: oh man, come on now. Y'all got to get up out of here with all that. Which one is it? Do you want change or do you not want change? - But if the poor man speak, they say, What fellow is this? Oh, because we ain't got millions of dollars like him. Cuz we not in the public light like him. Because we not on the social status that they're on. When we speak, they tell us shut up. But if they come out and say the same exact thing without using the Bible, now it's, oh man, he's speaking the truth, bro. - We got to stop the hypocrisy in our community. We loyal to sin and we betray true justice. Police kill us left and right. But when we bring out Esau going into slavery: oh, God love everybody. Y'all fight more for the other people than y'all do for y'all own salvation. **[Proverbs 24:24](/bible/proverbs/24#v24)** *[[12:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I29gmYaeFO0&t=776s)]* > [24](/bible/proverbs/24#v24) He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him: - He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous: that's what they do to these criminals in the community. That's a good brother right there. Look, he got his kids and he got his family. But yet he just destroyed one family. He just killed one child's father. He just killed one mother's son. But yet we got to stick to the hood code. Get the hell out of here. No. - Him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him: that's why black people are looked at the way they're looked at right now. We're an astonishment to the world, because we act evil, we promote evil, we love evil. And then all the nations hate us for it. That's why every time we move somewhere, it's, oh, there goes the neighborhood. Every time we come around, they want to make sure there's extra security. At rock concerts, they be having mosh pits. They got ambulances. If that happened at a black show, they're shutting the whole thing down. - We got to understand, we have to move different. The hood code is garbage. Leave it alone. **[Isaiah 59:4](/bible/isaiah/59#v4)** *[[14:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I29gmYaeFO0&t=872s)]* > [4](/bible/isaiah/59#v4) None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity. - This is why we need to change the narrative of our people. - None calleth for justice: but now we need to call for justice. Black men stop killing black men. Black women stop killing black women. Promote families. Be positive. - Nor any pleadeth for truth: nobody pleads for truth, but the Israelites going to do it. With or without your help, we are going to do it. And we're going to change the narrative of what our people have been putting out for decades. - They trust in vanity, and speak lies: they trust in things that don't profit. We got to understand, heaven ain't full. Everybody that die ain't going to heaven. Y'all be acting like everybody in the sky looking down on you. No, some of them looking up at you. Although we know that judgment has not come yet. Nobody's in actual heaven or hell right now. Let me just clear that up. I'm using that because people often say that the worst person in the damn hood, when they die, now they looking down on me. No, they not. They got to pay for what they did in their life. - They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity: this is what they do. But we have to change that. We have to be that right example. Forget the hood code. It's all about God's code. God's code says, be righteous. God's code said, love your neighbor as you love yourself. God's code said, marry your woman. Stick to God's code. Forget the hood code. ## In Closing *[[16:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I29gmYaeFO0&t=1002s)]* Now, that's the 15 minutes with the captain. It's all praise to the Most High. I could have went on a whole lot longer, but hey, y'all get the picture. Lord willing, somebody repent and actually start changing. All right? Shalom. --- [15 Minutes Index](/captains) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I29gmYaeFO0)
